notes.title: Charon's Staircase - Patch 1.5.9
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42379126/0909de954f3ad21ad3a268707c393e1e073b5225.png[/img]
Hello, everyone!

We're so excited to announce that the new [b][i]Charon's Staircase[/i][/b] update, [b]Patch 1.5.9[/b], is now live on [b]Steam[/b]! This update tackles several long-standing issues, including fixes for achievement unlocking problems and bugs that caused players to get stuck due to missing boundaries.

We’ve also made various other improvements to enhance your experience. Be sure to update your game and let us know what you think! Check out the Patch Notes below for more details.

[h3]Patch 1.5.9 Patch Notes (Steam):[/h3]
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Arabic Text: Resolved display issues in Item Information UI for better readability.
[*] In-Game Portraits: Added a "Read" option for portraits.
[*] Localization: Fixed missing translations in the localization file.
[/list]
 
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Achievements: Corrected missing achievements, incorrect unlocks, and fixed "A Lonely Death" achievement unlocking issue.
[*] Text Display: Fixed issue with inner monologue text staying on screen.
[*] Flickering Lights: Addressed screen flickering caused by in-game lights.
[*] Player Stuck Bug: Resolved issue with players getting stuck due to missing boundaries.
[*] Key Dismiss Option: Added a dismiss option for in-game keys.
[*] Checkpoint Restart: Fixed flashlight appearing unnecessarily after restarting in the mansion
[/list]

Thanks,
-SOEDESCO

notes.title: Digital Deluxe Edition and Patch notes!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3]


Today, we'll be releasing a [b]'Digital Deluxe Edition'[/b] of Charon's Staircase, this will include the base game, the soundtrack, and an art book.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42379126/7e4acbe910c715f548d77a5d1632213cab948880.jpg[/img]


[b]The patch will include the following fixes/features:[/b]

-Fixed a save/load issue that caused the 'Continue' button to stop working correctly.

-Fixed the selected mouse sensitivity setting not saving.

-Fixed some collectibles not showing up in the gallery.

-Fixed a scenario in which the goggles wouldn't respawn after dying in a certain section of the hospital.

-Fixed the missing lantern puzzle shadows on low and medium settings.

-Fixed a bug that caused the flashlight to be permanent.

-Added an option to remove the black bars at the top and bottom of the screen.

-Added an option to adjust the text size for reading documents.

-Added an option to turn off motion blur.

-Added button mapping.

-Added chapter select.

-Updated tarot puzzle localization. (Some languages had incorrect words/ spelling). 

-Updated piano puzzle localization. (Some languages had incorrect words/ spelling). 


Please let us know if there are still problems! 

Thank you for the support with the game. 

Robert & Indigo Studios

notes.title: Release date confirmed for first-person horror mystery game Charon's Staircase
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey Everyone,
[/h3]
We have confirmed the release date confirmed for the first-person horror mystery game Charon's Staircase.

The release date for the first-person horror mystery game Charon's Staircase. On October 28, 2022, the game will launch on Steam and Epic Games Store, and will also be available on PS4™, PS5™, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch both digitally and physically. 

In Charon's Staircase, players will take on the role of the agent "Desmond", and will be assigned the task of retrieving and destroying confidential documents that reveal the horrific past of numerous inhumane and sinister acts committed by The Ministry in the 1970s. However, something dark and ominous lurks around the corner, and a grisly discovery awaits - Project Alpha.

Here are some new in-game screenshots to celebrate the news: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42379126/482cd82c4ec41dc0b375bc35c9fe32a3a877ec07.png[/img]

Please check out our socials for the rest of the shots in the coming weeks! 

That's all for now. 

Thanks

- Robert
